title: Structure-guided delineation of umbelliferyl phosphate-based disruptors of the c-Myb-CBP/p300 KIX protein-protein interaction.
authors: Kamel, Emadeldin M; Rudayni, Hassan A; Allam, Ahmed A; Alfassam, Haifa E; Alqhtani, Haifa A; Abalkhail, Adil; Aba Alkhayl, Faris F; Lamsabhi, Al Mokhtar
one_liner_zh: 该文通过虚拟筛选、分子动力学模拟和MM/PBSA等方法，研究小分子破坏c-Myb与KIX结构域的蛋白-蛋白相互作用，虽涉及转录调控复合物，但核心是蛋白-蛋白而非蛋白-DNA互作，方法可迁移至TF-DNA界面建模。
abstract: The interaction between c-Myb and the CBP/p300 KIX domain is a critical transcriptional regulatory event and an attractive target for the development of candidate disruptors of the recombinant c-Myb-KIX interaction. In this study, we used an integrated computational and experimental strategy to identify new small molecules capable of disrupting this protein-protein interaction. A focused Umbelliferyl phosphate scaffold library was subjected to stepwise virtual screening via drug-likeness assessment and docking to the c-Myb-binding region of the KIX domain and short molecular dynamics refinement. Selected compounds were then evaluated by 500 ns molecular dynamics simulations, MM/PBSA analysis, free energy landscape (FEL) mapping, and finally by microscale thermophoresis (MST) assay. Computational analyses showed that stable ligand binding did not necessarily translate into disruption of the c-Myb-KIX interface, allowing separation of compounds that stabilized the complex from those predicted to weaken it. Consistent with this distinction, DeltaDeltaG(PPI)analysis identified only MUP and Naphthol AS-BI phosphate as protein-protein interaction-weakening ligands, with Naphthol AS-BI phosphate showing the strongest predicted disruptive effect (DeltaDeltaG(PPI)=+3.25 kcal/mol), whereas DiFMUP and Naphthol AS-D phosphate were predicted to stabilize the complex. Among the tested molecules, Naphthol AS-BI phosphate showed the clearest disruption-like behavior in silico and was the most potent inhibitor in vitro, with an IC(5)(0) of 18.9 +/- 0.6 muM. Importantly, MUP emerged as the most promising umbelliferyl phosphate-derived hit, displaying measurable inhibitory activity (IC(5)(0) = 33.5 +/- 0.3 muM) comparable to the reference Naphthol AS-E phosphate (IC(5)(0) = 31.2 +/- 1.3 muM) and a more favorable predicted ADMET profile. Overall, this work identifies new chemical starting points for targeting the c-Myb-CBP/p300 KIX interaction and supports MUP as an attractive scaffold for further optimization.
abstract_zh: c-Myb与CBP/p300 KIX结构域之间的相互作用是一个关键的转录调控事件，也是开发重组c-Myb-KIX相互作用干扰剂的吸引性靶点。在本研究中，我们采用整合的计算与实验策略，以识别能够破坏这种蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用的新型小分子。一个聚焦的伞形酮磷酸盐（Umbelliferyl phosphate）支架库通过药物相似性评估、对接至KIX结构域的c-Myb结合区域以及短时分子动力学（molecular dynamics）精化，进行了逐步虚拟筛选。选定的化合物随后通过500 ns分子动力学模拟、MM/PBSA分析、自由能景观（free energy landscape, FEL）映射，并最终通过微量热泳动（microscale thermophoresis, MST）实验进行评估。计算分析表明，稳定的配体结合并不必然转化为对c-Myb-KIX界面的破坏，从而能够将稳定复合物的化合物与预测会削弱复合物的化合物区分开来。与此区分一致，DeltaDeltaG(PPI)分析仅识别出MUP和Naphthol AS-BI phosphate为蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用削弱配体，其中Naphthol AS-BI phosphate显示出最强的预测破坏效应（DeltaDeltaG(PPI)=+3.25 kcal/mol），而DiFMUP和Naphthol AS-D phosphate则被预测为稳定复合物。在测试的分子中，Naphthol AS-BI phosphate在计算机模拟中表现出最清晰的破坏样行为，并在体外是最有效的抑制剂，其IC(5)(0)为18.9 ± 0.6 μM。重要的是，MUP成为最有前景的伞形酮磷酸盐衍生先导化合物，显示出可测量的抑制活性（IC(5)(0) = 33.5 ± 0.3 μM），与参考化合物Naphthol AS-E phosphate（IC(5)(0) = 31.2 ± 1.3 μM）相当，并具有更优的预测ADMET特征。总体而言，本研究为靶向c-Myb-CBP/p300 KIX相互作用确定了新的化学起点，并支持MUP作为进一步优化的吸引性支架。
